title: Run of the extended loop-body machine
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Form the loop-body machine from $B$ and $a$, and form its source machine by adjoining $1+F.k$ work tapes. For every configuration $c$ of the loop-body machine on input $x$, every choice of contents and head positions for those additional tapes, and every $t\in\mathbb N$, running the source machine for $t$ steps from the configuration obtained by adjoining the chosen tapes to $c$ gives the configuration obtained by adjoining those same tapes and head positions to the loop-body machine's configuration after $t$ steps from $c$.
